infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Lumi to use your microphone for voice check-ins.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow Lumi to transcribe your speech into tasks.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow Lumi to pick a person from your contacts for task details.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Lumi to access your location for nearby task reminders.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Lumi to alert you when you are near task locations.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Lumi to use your microphone for voice check-ins.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Lumi to transcribe your speech into tasks.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Meira tells you when you are near the place of an open errand, even when the app is closed. Your location stays on your phone.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Meira tells you when you are near the place of an open errand, even when the app is closed. Your location stays on your phone.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Meira uses your location for travel times and leave-now alerts.

plugins.contactsPermission: Lumi reads contacts to match names you mention.

plugins.calendarPermission: Meira reads your calendars (Outlook, work, family) to plan the journey to each meeting.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Meira to record what you say, so it can turn it into tasks.
